I found two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM. I only used Moss's notes that you can see: four North team digests and two Central team ones.

1. #PD-4492 comes from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth", dated 5 Oct 2025 (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting their SMS bay assignments on the 04:00 shift. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift got through without manual help.

2. #4419 comes from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Before these go in the weekly notes:
- The two numbers are in different formats (one has "PD-", one doesn't). Both involve Door 14, but they look like separate problems, one with SMS and one with scanners. The notes don't say whether they're related.
- Because the cheat sheet isn't dated, I can't tell when #4419 was logged or whether it's still open.
- Two other Moss digests mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers: the pipeline digest from 14 Sep 2025 and the renewal check-in from 23 Mar 2026.
- I left out #4409, #4412 and FR-882 because they belong to Central team accounts. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways", which is a different company and not a customer.
